`POST /v1/products/{productUID}/ext-devices/{deviceUID}/session/open`: Open an external device's session

This operation's complete contract, taken unchanged from [the OpenAPI
specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blues/skills/refs/heads/master/notehub-access/openapi.yaml)

  /v1/products/{productUID}/ext-devices/{deviceUID}/session/open:
    post:
      operationId: ExtDeviceSessionOpen
      summary: Open an external device's session
      description: |
        Open a session for an external device, adding the device if it's new. An open session is closed
        first, with `why_session_closed` as the reason. The DeviceUID gets `dev:ext:` as in

        Requires the Owner or Developer role. Returns 500 if webhooks are disabled for the project.
